entities.name: Velomachus Lorehold
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Arcavios that founded Strixhaven, a master of order and chaos magic.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The institution founded by the five dragons.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: The college named in Velomachus's honor.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane formed from the merger of Ezroi and Karudis.

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: A demiplane that merged with Karudis to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: A demiplane that merged with Ezroi to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Dean Lisette
entities.description: Dean of Witherbloom College, who reportedly cured Velomachus of a secret illness.

events.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, five vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres from which five dragons hatched.
events.quote: from which were hatched five dragons

events.summary: The dragons founded the institution that is now Strixhaven to study the five mana dichotomies.
events.quote: the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

events.summary: Velomachus was once cured of a secret illness by Dean Lisette.
events.quote: she was once cured of a secret illness by Dean Lisette of Witherbloom College

relations.quote: one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven
